snippet.title: Bloody Paws Unleashed - Leaving Early Access / Launch Trailer (Reupload)
snippet.description:
Available now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1491780/Bloody_Paws_Unleashed/

Rope-jumping mummies, invisible men, lazy superheroes, and the Frankenstein monster (on roller skates) are out to get you! Control a melodramatic werewolf on a quest to find his missing were-wife. Unleash your passion!

MORE MERSO ENTERTAINMENT:
Website: https://www.mersoentertainment.com/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mersoentertainment/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/MersoEnt

ABOUT THIS GAME:
Bloody Paws: Passion Unleashed is an official remake and expansion of the 1990 game Bloody Paws, which was developed in Spain by Mar Entertainment and released for the ZX Spectrum and MSX.

The original Bloody Paws is a curious item: a side-scrolling beat ‘em up in which players control a melodramatic werewolf on a quest to find his missing wife and fight a horde of eccentric creatures. The game also had an unfortunate behind-the-scenes story: the publisher released the game before it was completed, without even informing (or paying!) the developers.

In 2020, a completed version of Bloody Paws was released for the Amstrad CPC.

Merso Entertainment counts with the blessing of the creator of Bloody Paws, Juan Carlos Sanchez, to bring this cool relic of the past to PC. Free from the limitations of the 8-bit systems of the 80s, Bloody Paws: Passion Unleashed will inject the original game with color, gameplay polish, additional animations, extra levels, and more!

Featuring:
• Tongue-in-cheek, soap-opera inspired storyline. Bloody is yearning for his lover, and the wild beast won’t stop at anything until he gets her back!!
• Updated graphics and sound
• Multiple attack types and fast-paced action
• 6 playable stages, revamped and new
• Boss fights
• English, Spanish, and German language modes
